description: Points a business's domain and its www at its ChrisX website (hosted on Vercel). Applied at the root.
variableDescription: %ip%: the IPv4 address Vercel gives the root (76.76.21.21 or 216.198.79.1 today); %cname%: the CNAME target Vercel gives www (cname.vercel-dns.com, or a project-specific name under vercel-dns-0NN.com). Both are bare because Vercel hands out more than 1 value, as in vercel.com.website.
